Preparing for High-Volume Deployments GwayERP and ThiranERP are expected to be deployed to an increasing number of customers. Responsibilities Include: Identifying deployment bottlenecks. Automating repetitive deployment tasks. Improving deployment speed. Improving deployment reliability. Standardizing client deployment procedures. Supporting parallel deployment where appropriate. Maintaining deployment records. Learning and implementing suitable DevOps practices for higher deployment volumes. The candidate is expected to grow with the requirement and continuously improve the deployment system as the number of clients increases. Secure Client Deployment GwayERP And ThiranERP Applications May Be Deployed In: Customer on-premises servers Customer-preferred cloud servers Other approved customer environments The candidate will assist in developing a deployment architecture where the application can run securely in the customer's environment without unnecessarily exposing the organization's source code. The candidate should learn and work with concepts such as: Docker images Private container registries Build artifacts Runtime configuration Secrets management Access control Secure deployment packages Application versioning Container security The Objective Is: Customers should be able to run and use the ERP application without receiving unrestricted access to the development source code. The candidate should continuously research and recommend better approaches as the deployment model evolves. Application Updates & Release Management ERP Applications Will Continuously Receive: Bug fixes Security fixes New features Performance improvements Workflow enhancements The DevOps process must support updating existing client installations safely. The Candidate Will Assist In Building Processes For: New Release → Backup → Deployment → Database Migration → Verification Responsibilities Include: Preparing release packages/images. Data Safety During Deployment The candidate must follow deployment practices that protect customer data.
